def move(terrain, start, duration_s, n_runs, seed):
    import numpy as np
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    N = 60
    dt = duration_s / (N - 1)
    
    points = np.empty((n_runs, N, 3), dtype=np.float64)
    lat = np.full(n_runs, start[0])
    lon = np.full(n_runs, start[1])
    points[:, 0, 0] = lat
    points[:, 0, 1] = lon
    points[:, 0, 2] = 0.0
    
    inside = terrain.inside(lat, lon)
    ok = inside.copy()

    # Bearings: south = -pi/2, add noise ±30°
    base_bearing = -np.pi/2
    max_noise = np.pi/6  # 30 degrees
    
    m_lat = terrain.m_lat
    m_lon = terrain.m_lon
    cell_m = terrain.cell_m

    for i in range(1, N):
        # If any run already outside, we keep lat/lon but mark as outside at end
        # Compute elev and slope at current pos
        elev = terrain.elev(lat, lon)
        slope = terrain.slope_deg(lat, lon)
        
        # Generate bearing noise
        noise = rng.uniform(-max_noise, max_noise, size=n_runs)
        bearing = base_bearing + noise
        
        # Move cell_m meters along bearing as tentative step
        # Convert dist_m=cell_m to degree changes for lat/lon
        dlat = (cell_m * np.cos(bearing)) / m_lat
        dlon = (cell_m * np.sin(bearing)) / m_lon
        
        lat1 = lat + dlat
        lon1 = lon + dlon
        
        # Clamp positions inside terrain box
        lat1, lon1 = terrain.clamp(lat1, lon1)
        
        # Compute elevation at new position
        elev1 = terrain.elev(lat1, lon1)
        
        d_elev = elev1 - elev
        d_horiz = cell_m
        
        # Calculate speed using Tobler hiking function
        speed = terrain.tobler_speed_ms(d_elev, d_horiz)
        speed = np.maximum(speed, 0.1)  # Avoid zero speed
        
        # Calculate time to move cell_m meters
        dt_move = cell_m / speed
        
        # If dt_move > dt (duration per step), move proportionally closer
        # Move proportion = min(1, dt/dt_move) to not exceed duration per step
        move_frac = np.minimum(1.0, dt / dt_move)
        
        # Interpolate position accordingly
        lat_new = lat + move_frac * (lat1 - lat)
        lon_new = lon + move_frac * (lon1 - lon)
        elev_new = terrain.elev(lat_new, lon_new)
        
        # Update dt actual for each run
        actual_dt = move_frac * dt_move
        elapsed_time = points[:, i-1, 2] + actual_dt
        
        # Save steps
        points[:, i, 0] = lat_new
        points[:, i, 1] = lon_new
        points[:, i, 2] = elapsed_time
        
        # Update lat/lon for next iteration for runs still inside
        # But keep lat/lon if run already outside
        lat = np.where(ok, lat_new, lat)
        lon = np.where(ok, lon_new, lon)
        
        # Update inside mask
        inside = terrain.inside(lat, lon)
        ok = ok & inside
    
    return points, ok
